planting.note: Plant dormant crowns in early spring as soon as soil is workable; remove first-year flowers to build a strong root system.

directions: Polka is an older Dutch-bred June-bearing strawberry remembered chiefly for its rich, well-balanced, aromatic sweetness, a flavor profile that made it a favored parent behind several later Dutch cultivars, including Sonata. The medium-sized, bright red conical berries are softer and bruise more easily than modern commercial strawberries, which is largely why firmer, longer-shelf-life cultivars displaced it in large-scale production even as home growers kept it around for taste. Grow in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun with steady moisture through flowering and fruit swell, and plan on eating or preserving the crop quickly after picking rather than storing it for long.
sources: NIAB (National Institute of Agricultural Botany, UK)
